description: This file defines a class for the 'StyleAttribute' module within the HTMLPurifier library, specifically related to handling style attributes in HTML elements and configuring attribute collections.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_StyleAttribute
classes.description: A module class for handling style attributes in HTML, inheriting from HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule, with properties for module name and attribute collections, and a setup method to initialize CSS attribute definitions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the style attribute collection with a CSS attribute definition object.
